identity.name: Qwen1.5-32B
identity.summary: Qwen1.5 is a series of decoder-only language models available in multiple sizes, including the 32B variant.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only architecture, modality, and family; no design, training, or evaluation details for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card states the base model is not intended for direct text generation and recommends post-training before use, leaving intended use undefined.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not document training or tuning dataset details for Qwen1.5-32B.

possible_risks.description: Improper usage occurs when a model is used for a purpose that it was not originally designed for.
possible_risks.justification: Card explicitly says the base model is not intended for direct text generation, so using it directly for generation would be improper.

specifications.model_size: 60.6 GiB of safetensors weights (65,024,525,272 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model is a base language model and is not intended for direct text generation; the documentation recommends applying post-training techniques such as SFT, RLHF, or continued pretraining before use.
